title: Hole-doped BaB2: archived DFPT, EPW and Migdal-Eliashberg results (Bercx et al., PRX Energy 4, 033012 (2025))
material: BaB2 in the AlB2 structure (P6/mmm): one formula unit (Ba at 1a, B at 2d) per primitive cell; hexagonal B layers as in MgB2.
archive_readme_excerpt:
`bab2-analysis.zip`: Additional analysis on the two-gap candidate superconductor BaB2, as explained in the Supplementary Material. Contains three folders:

* `331`: phonon calculation of homogeneously 1-hole doped 3*3*1 supercell BaB2 which is shown in fig. S8.
* `331_cs`: phonon calculation of Cs-substituted 3*3*1 BaB2 supercell which is shown in fig. S8.
* `sensitivity`: sensitivity check of phonon dispersion, Alley-Dynes isotropic, anisotropic Tcs versus hole doping levels (0.0, 0.02, 0.04, 0.06, 0.065, 0.08, 0.1 hole/u.c.), as shown in fig.S7.
methods: Quantum ESPRESSO, PBE, 80 Ry cutoff, cold smearing 0.02 Ry, 12x12x8 k-points; holes added as a homogeneous background charge with the cell relaxed at each charge; DFPT on a 6x6x4 q-grid (21 irreducible points). EPW v5.8 with Wannier interpolation to 40x40x24 k and q grids; isotropic and anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg equations on the imaginary axis, continued to the real axis with Pade approximants. Supercells: 3x3x1 cells (27 atoms), phonons at two wave vectors. The returned input files and log lines record each run's settings.

dfpt_phonons.returns: harmonic frequencies at the 21 irreducible DFPT q-points (archived bab2.dyn1-21) with ph.in and the run header

a2f.returns: the archived EPW file bab2.a2f (rows as archived, with its first line and footer) and the run header

iso_log.returns: the archived isotropic Eliashberg input (iso.in) and the solver section of iso.out

aniso_gap.returns: the archived EPW gap-distribution file at one archived temperature, on the imaginary axis (bab2.imag_aniso_gap0_T) or continued to the real axis (bab2.pade_aniso_gap0_T), as archived (first line and two columns), with that temperature's log lines, epw_int.in and the run header

eliashberg_iso.returns: a new numpy solution of the isotropic Migdal-Eliashberg equations on the archived alpha2F of that run, at up to 8 temperatures (5-150 K)

supercell_phonons.returns: frequencies at the two archived supercell wave vectors with the scf/ph inputs, selected scf output lines (and the relaxation for 331_cs)

eliashberg_iso_solver: Matsubara frequencies w_n = (2n+1) pi kB T, n = 0..N-1, N = int((cutoff/(pi kB T) - 1)/2) + 1; with lambda(m) = int 2 w a2F(w)/(w^2 + (2 m pi kB T)^2) dw: Z_n = 1 + (pi kB T/w_n) sum_m [lambda(n-m) - lambda(n+m+1)] w_m/sqrt(w_m^2 + D_m^2); Z_n D_n = pi kB T sum_m [lambda(n-m) + lambda(n+m+1) - 2 mu*] D_m/sqrt(w_m^2 + D_m^2) (the form solved by EPW). Linear mixing D <- mixing*D_new + (1-mixing)*D_old from a constant initial gap; residual = sum|D_new - D_old|/sum|D_new|; a run stops when the residual falls below conv_thr, when D(iw_0) falls below 1e-6 meV (reported as zero), or at max_iter. Returns D(iw_0) in meV, Z(iw_0), N, the iteration count, the final residual and whether it converged.
